claims.quote: The test helper `attempt` reports a function in a program's value as Lion writes it, wherever it stands: `"even"` for the relation `even`, `["lambda", ["n"], "n"]` for a lambda. A program that ended in a declaration, such as `["begin", ["relation", "even", ["n"]]]`, made it throw `"undefined" is not valid JSON`, which failed the `why` property about rules that ask no question once in about 300 runs, and a function inside a list or a record was reported as `null` or left out. A property checks that two programs are reported the same only when their values are the same.

The property that a schema keeps the values its names had when it was declared checks every schema beside a `below` shape that decides whether the value fits, so the mutation that lets a shape see `limit` redefined after it is declared fails it within 4 runs. It took 38 to 104 runs before, and 1 run in 8 of 200 inputs passed.
